description: FLOW: measures whether AutoProgressionService's gear-axis dispatch (AutoCraftPlanner + AutoCraftExecutor) can drive a fresh character's gear tier upward within a balanced farming+crafting budget. Axes are (startingGearTier x playerLevel). Cells proxy the outcome via the standard combat sim — at each (gt,pl) cell, if auto-craft can *actually* pick a viable recipe and farm its ingredients, the combat win-rate against a representative monster at the player's level should match the tolerance band below. The proxy: starting gearTier 1 @ playerLevel 5 should reach gearTier 3 within ~30 simulated minutes (≈3 craft cycles at this scale). We encode the expected post-progression state (gearTier = starting+2) as the effective playerLevel bump — so cells where auto-craft is working read 'balanced' or 'easy'; cells where planning breaks down read 'hard' or 'punishing' (honest bug signal). Creative agent should revisit once live-play telemetry lands.
